EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT - MANUFACTURING WORKER
Hanbit Precision Co., Ltd., Ansan-si, Gyeonggi-do, South Korea

Employer: Hanbit Precision Co., Ltd.
Employee: Nguyen Van Minh, Passport No. B3344556 (Vietnam)
Duration: 12 months under the Employment Permit System (E-9 visa).
Pay: KRW 2,060,740 per month, paid on the 10th of each month.
Hours: 40 hours per week, 8 hours per day, excluding breaks, as set by the Labor Standards Act.
Passport: the employer will keep the employee's passport and alien registration card in the company safe for the duration of the visa.
Recruitment: the employee paid the placement agency KRW 1,500,000 in fees for arranging this job, in addition to the government fee.
Termination: the employer may end this contract at any time without notice or stated reason, at its sole discretion.
Rest: one paid weekly holiday, usually Sunday.
Governed by the Labor Standards Act and the Foreign Employment Act.

Signed: Kim Jong-Ho (Employer) Nguyen Van Minh (Employee)
Date: 5 August 2026
